name: Miseki Soubi
source: [url=/c155151]Ruriiro[/url]'s twin sister, a third-year student, attending the same school as him. Due to albinism, she has silver hair, and crimson-colored eyes, her peculiar beauty captivates both men and women. For someone of her age, she has an exceptional talent for videography, and has won several awards for her works. The only fly in the ointment is her weak constitution.
